packages: The exact runtime package set and source and resource paths from runtime-package-v1.json.
acceptance: Apply the fixed package metadata transform, install offline through Composer, verify exact installed source and resource bytes, verify dependency metadata, and observe every registered root through installed autoload.
fault: Append a newline to one installed PHP file after its healthy measurement. Require exact installed-path digest rejection.
trust: Pinned package split recipe and package contract
Composer invoked without plugins, scripts, network or development dependencies
Staged local package installations and their measured provenance

runtimeRoles.inventory: Every closed concrete role in the pinned constructor contracts, reconciled with the independent PHP inventory in the review bundle.
runtimeRoles.observation: Load each role through the installed Composer loader. Record and check the exact reflected name, kind, installed source path and in-container source hash. Every concrete role is final. Preserve the publication probes of every root.

controls.omitted-role: Remove a known role from the measurement and require the coverage check to fail.
controls.wrong-source: Replace one measured path by another installed source path and require the path check to fail.

enumRoutes.observation: For each registered IR enum, native case constants, cases(), from(), tryFrom() and serialized restoration identify the same declared singleton. Verify unknown backing values through from() and tryFrom(). Check the installed ordered cases against the independently read PHP source and the fixed shape rules.
enumRoutes.fault: Delete one observed installed enum case while leaving its role, source path and bytes untouched. Require the independent case comparison to reject.

sqliteCheckPublication: Analyze a CREATE TABLE with checked keys and an inline named CHECK through the installed SQLite Semantics API. Verify the final operand role, owner slot, label and different referenced slot.
sqliteRenamePublication: Exercise both SQLite rename roots through installed analyze(), preserving the absolute table and explicit rewrite mode of a column destination.
mysqlIntegralCasts: Preserve separate signed and unsigned operands, and check both new MySQL set-result enum cases through the installed Composer paths.
sqliteFoldedChecks: Execute the installed SQLite analyze() path on a named CHECK with a discarded subquery. Require the exact folded decision and ordered marker labels, including distinct zero padding on the repeated slot.
postgresWideCast: Analyze a nested bigint to integer conversion and a standalone bigint endpoint. Verify both signed widths and exact decimal payloads through the installed Composer loader.
postgresTypedParameters: Analyze distinct int4 and int8 input slots and a second cast of one int8 slot. Verify the slot input types, slot reuse and independent int4 conversion in each installed package.
sqliteImplicitChecks: Exercise an unnamed CHECK with a comparison glyph, original whitespace and a zero prefix. Observe the declared column, the exact presentation and the resolved operation through both installed Composer profiles.
sqliteGeneratedColumns: Publish an installed SQLite CREATE TABLE with a forward STORED generated reference and an implicit VIRTUAL column. Compare the concrete roles, storage modes and resolved column slots.
sqliteDropView: Load the view removal root through the installed SQLite analyzer, check its resolved absolute view and missing-object policy, and render it.
sqliteJoinedLocalSource: Publish and render an installed SQLite WITH SELECT that reads the same VALUES definition twice. Verify the shared definition object, two distinct occurrence slots, and a single local definition marker registration.
sqliteCoalesce: Publish an installed IFNULL call with an explicit NULL followed by a numbered argument. Verify the two ordered roles and the exact marker after canonical COALESCE rendering.
localDiagnostic: A host PHP run may stage the same packages and compare all roots and sources against exact relocated paths. It records a separate status and PHP version. The acceptance bundle requires the isolated worker image.
sqliteCreateView: Publish an installed CREATE VIEW under main/temp source shadowing. Check the resolved owning schema and source, ordered effective names and exact rendering.
sqliteCreateViewGrouped: Publish an installed grouped view and compare its effective output names, fixed body role and GROUP BY and COUNT semantics in the emitted SQL.

mutationReplay.evidence: Reconstruct the altered bytes, exact unified diff and detector receipt from the verified candidate source. Reject a wrong after digest or a different injected diff.

sqliteCreateViewCompound: Publish an installed compound view and verify the two checked arm roles, exact union operation, ordered output name and rendered definition.
sqliteCreateViewLocal: Check an installed view that reads the same local definition twice. Verify the shared concrete object, the two resolved occurrence slots, and the one emitted definition.
sqliteResolvedViewInput: Observe an installed SELECT from a previously declared view, including its external kind, absolute schema and consumed slot.
sqliteMergedJoins: Both installed distributions must publish the two ordered FULL operands in a view and retain the distinct RIGHT star and explicitly qualified slots.
mysqlTextLiteral: Observe installed decoding, checked labels and canonical emission of an adjacent MySQL string with a zero byte and supplementary code point. Inspect both release cohorts' connection collations.
mysqlVarcharPublication: Use the installed direct analyzer for a declaration with inherited utf8mb4_bin, an explicit collated projection, a MIN and DISTINCT MAX over the same resolved field, and an ordered mixed-kind INSERT SELECT. Verify exact destination types and positions, operand classes and scope, DISTINCT, aliases and SQL in both Composer layouts.
mysqlDerivedVarcharPublication: Observe exact occurrence and local field type in a LEFT JOIN. Derive the native VARCHAR length and collation from its readonly physical source, recognize the signed adjacent slot, reject the absent slot by returning null, and compare emitted SQL.
mysqlLocalVarcharPublication: Observe an installed local projection from a derived SELECT that exports a signed INT and a native VARCHAR. Reorder the local slots, retain duplicate result names and compare the native text field role and emitted SQL.
mysqlVarcharDeclaration: Observe an installed MySQL VARCHAR declaration both through direct construction and through analyze. Match ordered typed column definitions, inherited collation, existence policy, padded default operand, release profile and exact SQL in both installed Composer layouts.
mysqlSignedDeclaration: Inspect native TINYINT, MEDIUMINT and BIGINT widths in installed declarations, preserve both exact BIGINT endpoints and the required flag, verify rendered SQL, and require the same construction boundary to reject a TINYINT default above range.
mysqlPrimaryKey: Observe an installed composite primary key resolved against the owning declaration and compare it to directly constructed positional terms in the Schema/Key namespace. Verify ASCII name binding, effective nullability, inferred default absence, index direction, and exact emitted SQL.
postgresSignedDefault: Inspect installed PostgreSQL declarations with an int8 operand narrowing to SMALLINT, an explicit int8 of an in-range value and a native text assignment. Verify the exact decimal, source role and emitted SQL.
postgresBooleanDefault: Observe installed Boolean columns with both direct input conversion and an explicit builtin cast. Compare exact storage, resolved truth values, nullability and rendered SQL.
postgresTextStorage: Observe a native text declaration through the installed PostgreSQL facade, including its builtin role, decoded default and emitted native SQL.
postgresTextLiteral: Publish an installed unqualified SELECT text literal and verify exact decoded bytes, the resolved text role, the native output label and explicitly typed rendering.
postgresTextMarkers: Publish an installed PostgreSQL marker with a resolved text input. Verify its exact ordinal, type and native marker rendering.
postgresTypedColumns: Exercise a text field written both unqualified and qualified, alongside an integer field. Verify its native kind, exact occurrence slot, output names and rendered read after installation. Observe TextColumnReference in the dialect source namespace. The unqualified declaration precedes a temporary table named text; the installed analyzer preserves its builtin field kind.
postgresDerivedText: Publish a native text reference to a derived heading through installed packages. Observe both native kinds, the ordered occurrence and slot, and its corresponding generated ordinal alias.
postgresTypedReturning: Through installed analyze(), publish a DELETE with ordered text and integer RETURNING positions and retain both distinct native reference roles and names.
postgresTypedUpdate: Publish a text swap through installed analyze(). Observe the two same-target native assignments and their opposite old-row read positions.
postgresTypedInsert: Construct an installed mixed VALUES INSERT whose write order differs from the physical declaration. Verify the native slot kinds, exact written order, empty text and preserved integer payload.
postgresTypedInsertQuery: Publish an installed SELECT-to-INSERT with two native target kinds, DISTINCT, and a NULL specialized to its checked text destination.
postgresNullableKinds: Exercise each nullable kind lookup through installed PHP. A checked native field returns the enum singleton and an absent ordinal returns null.
postgresBooleanFields: Observe installed native Boolean reads of one unqualified and one qualified field, verify equality to a directly constructed coordinate and to the truth-test operand, and compare native layout and rendered SQL.
postgresBooleanReturning: Use installed analyze and direct field construction to verify a typed Boolean DELETE filter and its same target coordinate in RETURNING. Compare output names and emitted SQL.
postgresBooleanWrites: Compare installed literal Boolean write slots, explicitly typed DISTINCT NULL, and old-row field coordinates of a two-field Boolean swap.
postgresBooleanInput: Inspect the installed assignment conversion of an unknown literal and an explicitly typed DISTINCT projection. Require the ordinary and cast Boolean roles, their exact values and a typed rejection of DISTINCT with an uncast unknown literal.
postgresInt8Field: Inspect the installed grouped and qualified reads of a native BIGINT and its explicit int4 narrowing. Require a wide reference with the same scope and the same slot under all three consumers.
postgresOutputOrder: Check an installed grouped result alias shadowing a differently typed input, the exact ordered result positions, direction and NULL placement, and LIMIT with OFFSET.
postgresSourceOrder: Check bounded ordering by a nonprojected native field and that the same qualified field is converted to its owned position when projected under DISTINCT.
postgresSignedWrites: Observe the exact signed 64-bit literal, target role, returned field and distinct old-row reference during a direct analyze call from both installed layouts.
postgresSignedComparison: Check the loaded comparison role and ordered int8 and int4 reference coordinates in projected and WHERE comparisons.
postgresGroupedBounds: Verify that installed grouped analysis resolves a named aggregate and group key to ordered output positions with LIMIT and OFFSET.
mysqlCreateView: Load a declared view with an explicit catalog heading, algorithm and security policy. Check a literal filtered body in the old MySQL profile emits DUAL.
mysqlDropView: Resolve a conditional absent MySQL view in the installed catalog, check the exact schema, operation and missing policy, and emit the native equivalent.
mysqlHaving: Observe a grouped aggregate alias and a shadowing signed grouping field in the loaded predicate, retain its wide threshold and compare the exact SQL.
mysqlWithProjection: Load a two-definition ordinary WITH, check exact lexical coordinates and native emission, and confirm both publication routes reject a WITH on the two older MySQL releases.
mysqlExternalViews: Inspect a loaded MySQL ordinary view read, exact native VARCHAR storage and collation, renamed fields and base-only write placement.
postgresExternalSourceKinds: Inspect installed relation kinds for a declared ordinary view and materialized view, with exact qualified rendering, and require a typed refusal at a mutation boundary.
postgresGroupedHaving: Exercise a hidden aggregate, exact owned source slot and bigint comparison in HAVING through installed analysis and rendering.
postgresSignedRangeWidths: Check installed bigint field binding and the explicit typed NULL role in native distinctness and its qualified rendering.
postgresWithProjection: Verify both installed lexical definition coordinates, the materialization policy, final result slot and exact ordinary WITH SQL.
postgresDropView: Installed analysis publishes the ordinary and materialized view kinds with exact schema identities and native dependency policy.
postgresValues: Installed analysis publishes a rectangular constant table with an independently checked positional boolean and bigint heading.
postgresLocalValues: Installed WITH publication preserves native VALUES heading, generated slots and ordinary materialization.
postgresValuesCompound: Installed PostgreSQL publishes a compound whose unchecked coercions and syntax grouping cannot be substituted for its exact VALUES leaf kinds.
postgresCreateView: Installed persistent PostgreSQL view publication verifies a resolved heading, native options, and checked source coordinates.
postgresMaterializedView: Installed PostgreSQL materialized definition and refresh preserve their absolute identities, query and population policies.
postgresCreateTableAs: Installed PostgreSQL table-as-query publishes its immutable copied heading, query profile and native persistence, collision and population policy.
postgresTableRename: Installed name changes preserve distinct table and column roles, qualifying the absolute relation and retaining ONLY on a column change.
mysqlOrderedTableRename: Installed MySQL rename moves keep the physical origin when the current name was produced by an earlier step.
postgresTruncate: Installed PostgreSQL truncations retain duplicate occurrences, their distinct flags and both explicit policies.
mysqlTruncate: Installed MySQL truncations retain both kinds of checked absolute table identity, the release and native qualification.
mysqlSessionTableSources: Load all external relation kinds and verify that the installed PHP retains session-local ownership through SELECT and INSERT when a permanent declaration shares the exact name.
mysqlShadowedViewRemoval: Observe that installed DROP VIEW binds an existing persistent view despite its temporary overlay and treats a temporary-only name as optional persistent absence.
mysqlSessionDrop: Observe the ordinary and temporary native policy independently of target kind, with exact absolute operand order and the explicit absence role.
mysqlSessionCreateTable: Observe the same fully qualified temporary table declaration from an installed direct constructor and the installed analyzer, including the sealed target namespace, absolute schema and native SQL.
mysqlCreateLike: Observe installed direct construction and analysis of the same namespace-aware table definition copy, along with the exact SQL and invariant against repeating an absolute coordinate.
mysqlCreateTableAs: Compare both installed construction routes for an absolute temporary query-backed declaration. Preserve its exact query heading, signed cast, existence policy and release. Require constructor refusal of a duplicate heading.
sqliteAddColumn: Use the installed SQLite analyzer and direct construction for a literal-default column addition. Verify absolute identity, resolved heading and strictness, rejection of a duplicate, and isolation from changes through the caller’s referenced array element.
sqliteGeneratedColumnAddition: Use installed SQLite analysis and direct reconstruction to check an appended STORED generated value with an absolute target, a copied prior heading and a reference to its declared input slot.
sqliteColumnDefaultExpressions: Use both installed column declaration entry points to verify concrete computed defaults, binary association, and structurally emitted SQL.
sqliteAppendedChecks: Analyze named ordinary and generated inline CHECK conditions against a resolved target, observe closed labels and old and new input slots, and ensure an installed constructor detaches an element alias before publication.
sqliteImplicitAppendedChecks: Observe one implicit comparison's exact checked spelling and source slot and the native effect of an explicit name inherited by a later inline CHECK through installed analyze in both Composer layouts.
sqliteDropColumn: Publish a checked DropColumn through installed analyze with a temporary-table shadow, a retained generated dependency, and the exact declared ordinal to remove. Check deep detachment from a caller-owned heading alias and a typed refusal of a declaration-locally protected field.
sqliteCreateIndex: Analyzes a checked unique partial index under native temporary shadow selection with a single-quoted bound key and inert parameter registrations. Compares exact key and predicate before and after an installed direct construction detaches its key list.
sqliteIndexExpressionSpelling: Observe retained native SQLite CAST names and the binary IFNULL builtin through installed analysis and direct expression and index construction. Require semantic names and ordinals, the exact SQL, and rejection of an inconsistent native target.
sqliteDropIndex: Compare ordinary index removal through installed direct construction and analysis. Verify the absolute owner resolved through temporary shadowing, unqualified and empty named absence scopes, and failure of an unguarded absent target.
sqliteConstraintIndexNames: Use the installed catalog to observe a protected WITHOUT ROWID primary key and a known absent automatic name, including exact guarded SQL and typed refusal.
sqliteReindex: Verify installed REINDEX name precedence and the absolute qualified table or index. Observe builtin selector preservation and its checked direct index construction.
sqliteAnalyzeStatistics: Observe the native schema-first and index-before-relation choices in installed SQLite. Compare reconstructed bound indices, absolute schema qualification and view kind.
sqliteFlagPragmas: Observe a typed writable_schema reload, the native modulo-byte bound and qualified read through the installed SQLite Semantics API, with direct construction and an invalid reset control.
sqliteTableMetadata: Verify native metadata publication through both installed layouts. Check a resolved temporary shadow, builtin catalog alias and the legacy table_list filter, and reconstruct a table inspection from its published fields.
sqliteConnectionInventory: Observe native inventory publication through installed SQLite Semantics. An explicit temp access remains bound, numeric source operands ignored by SQLite omit no semantic operand, and another registry remains a different enum case.
sqliteIndexMetadata: Observe the selected physical primary index of an installed WITHOUT ROWID table lookup. The native table alias and automatic index name keep exactly the same resolved coordinate.
sqliteForeignKeyAudit: Check distinct native publication for a selected temporary child, the default bound main schema, and the implicit temporary catalog alias through the installed loader.
sqliteIntegrityAudit: Check a bound temporary relation with implicit native scope, a signed numeric report budget and a catalog reconstruction through the installed loader.
sqliteHeaderPragma: Check the installed writer's signed lower bound and attached scope, rebuild it directly and verify a read-only field with an unused argument.
sqliteVacuum: Check a resolved attached copy with a numbered filename, the direct rebuild and temporary inert registration through the installed loader.
sqliteConnectionCommands: Exercise attached file and key parameters and resolved detachment with case-equivalent spelling through the installed loader.
sqlitePagePragmas: Exercise the capped pager limit on an attached database, the native zero fallback write and the read-only count through the installed loader.
sqliteReclaimPragmas: Use the installed loader to resolve mode changes and incremental limits on an attached database.
sqliteCachePragmas: Observe distinct live and persistent capacities and the exact combined selected threshold and connection switch through the installed loader.
sqliteAuditTriggers: Resolve an attached stored trigger's old and new images and destination, and construct the same checked declaration through the installed classes.
sqliteDropTriggers: Bind a TEMP trigger watching an attached relation above a persistent same-name sibling. Reconstruct its installed removal and verify the three guarded absence scopes.
sqliteTriggerMutations: Rebuild an ordered trigger UPDATE and DELETE directly, distinguish local and image operands, and preserve the comparison orientation and conflict policy in the installed classes.
sqliteTriggerInsertBatches: Read the same ordered destination slots in every row, and reconstruct a multi-row trigger insertion as one statement through the installed value roles.
sqliteTriggerRaise: Bind a guarded RAISE with separate OLD message and NEW predicate fields. Copy the installed control action and preserve its exact policy and SQL.
postgresDropIndex: Observe the installed temporary index shadow, typed missing namespace, guarded refusal and detached ordered reconstruction in the split packages.
postgresCreateBtree: Observe resolved table kinds and positions, repeated covering columns, physical ordering, guarded occupancy and detached reconstruction from installed types.
postgresPartialBtree: Bind the qualified predicate of an installed partial B-tree to a physical slot and rebuild the checked filter directly.
postgresBooleanIndexPredicate: Reconstruct a qualified nested partial predicate from public installed classes and compare exact leaf positions, composition and rendered SQL.
postgresIndexTruthTest: Bind a qualified native IS NOT UNKNOWN condition to its Boolean slot and compare direct construction in the installed package.
postgresIndexBooleanValue: Preserve the qualified and negated native Boolean read with direct reconstruction from installed value roles.
postgresReindexIndex: Verify temporary shadowing, ordered native options, qualified persistent selection and direct and batch publication from the installed packages.
postgresReindexConstraintIndex: Publish an installed named key index through its distinct target type and reject a database-qualified selector before publication.
postgresReindexTable: Observe a materialized-view index owner and a temporary table shadow, directly reconstruct the installed value and reject a cross-database table target.
postgresLocalCatalog: Check that an installed analyzer binds a verified current database qualifier to the same local source and slot and refuses an unrelated catalog before publishing.
postgresReindexSchema: Observe one dotted namespace identifier, the effective concurrency request and direct reconstruction through the installed package.
postgresReindexPartitionTable: Observe exact bound branch and attached leaf roles in different namespaces and direct reconstruction from the installed packages.
postgresReindexPartitionIndex: Observe explicit partition root and leaf index roles and reconstruct the exact selected physical index using the installed public constructor.
postgresReindexDatabase: Verify that the installed analyzer resolves the current database and preserves the requested concurrent rebuild.
postgresReindexSystemCatalogs: Observe the system scope and exact database identity through installed analysis and direct reconstruction.
postgresReindexExclusionIndex: Verify the named exclusion target from analyzed and direct construction, preserve temporary requested mode, and reject persistent concurrency in the installed package.
postgresReindexVerbose: Observe ordered VERBOSE option binding and its rendered prefix through each installed rebuild root.
postgresReindexPlacement: Require the exact effective named tablespace on each installed REINDEX root, independently reconstruct the placed emitters, and reject an undeclared destination before publication.
postgresDropSchema: Check the installed analyze, analyzeAll and public constructor paths, ordered known and absent namespace roles, detached list ownership and the guard refusal.
postgresCreateSchema: Verify guard, declared decoded ownership, native session ownership roles and analyzed, batch, and direct namespace creation through the installed package.
postgresSchemaTables: Exercise an atomic schema with ordered typed table children, a differing guarded repeat, a detached child array, and a checked parent-child release and placement boundary through installed classes.
postgresAlterSchema: Observe separate installed rename and ownership roots, exact names and roles, direct reconstruction, and refusal before publication when a required named owner or schema is unresolved.
postgresCreateSequence: Observe directly installed sequence declaration, nominal name and persistence, signed storage and separate catalog and initial values, and an invalid generator parameter refusal from the installed publication.
postgresSchemaSequences: Exercise the installed two-phase CREATE SCHEMA value, a resolved sequence namespace and generator start, first sequence before a guarded same-name table, direct reconstruction and cross-namespace rejection.
postgresDropSequence: Exercise installed ordered sequence removal, exact pg_temp identity, guarded qualification and unqualified absence, direct reconstruction, and direct absence rejection.
postgresSequenceOwner: Observe an installed qualified owner role and column, direct reconstruction and rejection of an unresolved owner field.
postgresRenameSequence: Observe the installed shared selector, current temporary sequence priority, quoted rename destination, direct reconstruction and a same-coordinate refusal.
postgresMoveSequence: Observe the installed checked source and destination roles, exact namespace spelling, direct and batch reconstruction, ignored destination for guarded absence, and refusal of an undeclared destination.
postgresReconfigureSequence: Exercise the same checked assignment set from direct construction, analyze and analyzeAll, and verify the closed omitted, default, and explicit value roles, detached guarded absence and constructor refusal through the installed packages.
postgresSequenceLogging: Exercise the installed ordered mode list, detached referenced PHP array input, direct and batch construction, impossible prefix, and an absent guarded input whose actions are unevaluated.
postgresSequenceAuthorization: Exercise the installed sequence-specific producer, detached interleaved action list, retained distinction between a decoded and a native session principal, analyzeAll, and guarded absent operation.
postgresSequenceAccess: Exercise named and schema-set selection, PUBLIC versus a decoded quoted role, native GRANTED BY, retained grant-options, cascade and restrict, detached direct operands, and the installed single and batch analyze paths.
postgresSequenceDefaultAccess: Exercise both default privilege roots, detached ordered creator and schema scope, default scope for the effective creator, recipient roles, grant options and rejection before installed publication.
postgresSchemaViews: Observe the installed CREATE SCHEMA with resolved table and view in native phase order, independently reconstruct a detached view list and reject a missing local provider.
postgresSchemaIndexes: Exercise installed namespace index composition on the earlier table, retain local physical keys, preserve guarded view collision and reconstruction including detached array members, and reject a mismatched index occupancy.
postgresSchemaSequenceGrants: Observe installed ordered sequence grant members with a child selecting a resolved local sequence and native role tokens, detached reconstruction, unrelated state and exact rejection for a missing local sequence.
postgresSchemaViewDependencies: Inspect installed dependent view source kind, earlier local identity, typed NULL exposure, preserved ordered headings and direct sequence reversal refusal. Exercise standalone creation over a declared ordinary view.
postgresSchemaViewReplacement: Exercise compatible ordered CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW inside a schema in the installed package, exact replacement and appended typed field references, a plain text result and a direct rejection of an invalid prefix.
postgresPrimaryKey: Observe the installed optional ordinary primary key, exact role order, INCLUDE copy and nullability. Reconstruct its declaration and reject a key without a local table field.
postgresUniqueKey: Compare the installed retained unique and primary effects, physical slots, first explicit name transfer and direct NULL policy. Require no mutable list aliases.
postgresTableWidth: Observe direct and analyzed installed zero-field and 1600-field heaps with exact end columns and refusal of the 1601st field.
